LanguageData.FB_FleshArchitectBrainHemogelTooltip: Hemogel stored in this map's connected network reserves, including the umbilicus lunar link. Flesh Architect spends this reserve when growing organs.
LanguageData.FB_FleshArchitectBrainHemogelTooltipDev: Hemogel stored in this map's connected network reserves, including the umbilicus lunar link. Dev mode ignores building costs, but the real reserve is shown here.
LanguageData.FB_GrowOrganoidCopy_Desc: Select a place to grow another {0} through the Flesh Architect.
LanguageData.FB_CopyFleshmassWallPlan_Desc: Select cells where the colony should grow more flesh walls.
LanguageData.FB_CopyFleshmassBoneWallPlan_Desc: Select existing flesh walls that should be reinforced by the colony.
LanguageData.FB_ClearColonyEyes_Desc: Remove colony eye organs in the selected cells.
LanguageData.FB_GrowColonyEye_Desc: Grow a sensory eye directly from an empty patch of colony flesh.
LanguageData.FB_GrowFleshPlant_Desc: Grow {0} from colony flesh. The plant starts newly sprouted.
LanguageData.FB_GrowGrassEyes_Desc: Grow eye grass from colony flesh. The plant starts newly sprouted.
LanguageData.FB_GrowFleshTree_Desc: Grow a flesh tree from colony flesh. The plant starts newly sprouted.
LanguageData.FB_FleshPlantTreeRoofed: Flesh trees cannot grow under roofs.
LanguageData.FB_EmbryoGrowthForbiddenInPocketMap: {0} cannot be grown on the flesh moon or inside pocket maps.
LanguageData.FB_DevFinishMaturationDesc: Immediately completes this embryo's maturation if the mature form can be placed.
LanguageData.FB_ColonyBrain_Structure_TentacleTurret_: Grows a stationary fleshbeast defense that launches keratin spines at distant intruders and lashes nearby enemies with heavy tentacles.
LanguageData.FB_LocalFleshRelocateBuilding_Desc: Select a player-controlled flesh building, then choose a new flesh-covered destination on the same map.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonRelocateBuilding_Desc: Select a player-controlled flesh building on this map, then choose a flesh-covered destination on the linked map.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonRelocationNoLinkedMap: No linked surface or flesh moon map is available from this map.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonRelocationSelectSource: Select a flesh building to relocate.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonRelocationInvalidSource: Choose a valid spawned flesh building.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonRelocationMustBeFleshBuildin: Only organic flesh buildings can be relocated.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonRelocationMustBePlayerOwned: Only player-controlled flesh buildings can be relocated.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonRelocationForbiddenBuilding: This structure is anchored to colony systems and cannot be relocated.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonRelocationAttachedUnsupporte: Buildings with wall attachments or attachment buildings cannot be relocated yet.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonRelocationCannotPlaceHere: Cannot place the relocated building here.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonRelocationTargetBlocked: The destination footprint must be empty.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonRelocationBlockedByAcid: Remove the gastric acid before relocating a building here.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonRelocationTargetReserved: Another relocation is already growing into this footprint.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonRelocationInProgress: This building is already being relocated.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonRelocationFailed: Failed to relocate {0}; it was returned if possible.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonRelocationCancel_Desc: Stop the relocation while the structure is still being absorbed.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonRelocationCancelCannot: This relocation can no longer be canceled.
LanguageData.FB_VeinAnchorAlreadyHere: There is already an anchor here.
LanguageData.FB_VeinAnchorBend_Desc: Mark a point veins should curve through. A bend anchor only shapes veins that already pass nearby on their way to an organ.
LanguageData.FB_VeinAnchorRemove_Desc: Remove vein anchors of any kind in the selected cells.
LanguageData.FB_VeinAnchorModeHint: Right-click the button to switch mode. Junctions are red, endpoints orange, bends blue.
LanguageData.FB_VeinAnchorBranch_Desc: A point veins can start from, like the heart itself. The heart runs a channel out to it, and organs, endpoints and further junctions closer to it than to the heart are fed from here.
LanguageData.FB_VeinAnchorEndpoint_Desc: A point a vein grows out to and ends, even with no organ there. It is fed by the nearest source: the heart or a junction anchor.
